_contract: Terminal record for attempt 1 of the Phase-C2 full joint re-search. It created NO provider resource, spent NOTHING, and produced no scientific measurement. It is engineering evidence that the $0 gates work.
classification: PRE-PROVIDER GATE REFUSAL at $0 — the chain is consumed, no science began

what_happened.refusal: the readiness record is None, not 'launch_bound'. Only a launch-bound record describes the tree a launch will use.
what_happened._the_defect: `readiness_gate` asked `record.get("kind")` while the recorder writes `record_kind`, as do the shared pod_environment.verify_record and every other session's launcher. The gate therefore refused every launch-bound record it was ever shown -- an accept path that could not pass -- and reported the kind as None for a record that had just swept PASS with 18 passed, 0 skipped, 0 failed.
what_happened._regression: tests/pod/test_phase_c2_full_search_chain.py::test_the_readiness_gate_reads_the_key_the_recorder_writes, which fails when the defect is reinstated
what_happened._a_second_gap_the_same_pass_exposed: there was no full-search bundle stager. stage_c2_bundle.py is bound to Search-1's transport and record schema. scripts/autoinit/stage_c2_full_search_bundle.py now exists.

why_a_new_attempt_identity: the launcher records a run when it is invoked, and a recorded run is not reopened -- its manifest describes an execution a second invocation would overwrite. So this chain is CONSUMED even at $0, exactly as the grant's one_use rule states: 'consumed_when: the formal launcher is invoked under this authorization, whether or not a provider resource follows and whether or not any money is spent.' The standing maintainer rule (AGENTS.md P12.1) is that a formal launcher invocation aborting before measurement is an ENGINEERING subrun: preserve and close it, diagnose, repair, and build a FRESH chain under a new attempt identity without another approval. The incrementing attempt number is not a scope expansion and the cumulative budget is unchanged.

no_science_began._so_nothing_is_owed_to_review: review must be returned to when formal measurement has begun and the session is lost. Nothing began: the abort is nine gates into a $0 pass.

superseded_artifacts._why: all three were rebuilt under this run id AFTER the gate refused and BEFORE the launcher revealed that a recorded run cannot be reopened. They describe a chain that can never execute: the authorization binds run_id attempt1, whose manifest already exists, so the launcher refuses to open it. An issued authorization sitting in a consumed run's governance directory reads as current, which is the one thing it must not do.
superseded_artifacts._what_remains_here: the grant, the aborted session record and this closeout -- the evidence that nine $0 gates passed and the tenth refused, which is what this attempt is for.
superseded_artifacts._the_live_chain_is: attempt2, built fresh under its own grant

budget._basis: no provider resource was created. The abort happened during the pre-provider gate pass, before any create call.
budget._key_name_matters: derive_budget.py reads budget.this_attempt or cost.actual_usd. A cost recorded under any other name does not reach the project book, which is how engineering spend has gone missing here before.
